patterns.note: The hero section features a dynamic, full-width illustration that completely transforms its scene and content as the user scrolls down, rather than simply parallaxing or fading, revealing new landscapes and elements.
The page uses full-bleed, distinct color-blocked sections to segment content, creating clear visual breaks and a sense of progression down the page.
A high-contrast typographic system pairs elegant, large serif headings with clean, readable sans-serif body and accent text, creating a sophisticated yet approachable feel.

A vibrant, almost pastel-like palette of light greens, blues, and yellows is used for section backgrounds, providing a playful yet clean aesthetic that contrasts with the dark text and rich illustration colors.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a canvas-based animation (likely using GSAP or Lottie) to create a scroll-triggered scene transformation, where the entire illustrative content changes to reveal new landscapes and elements as the user scrolls.
Content sections are introduced with full-bleed background colors that shift between light pastel tones, providing clear visual segmentation and a sense of progression down the page.
A sticky navigation bar maintains site access while the main content scrolls beneath it, ensuring consistent access to key navigation items.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller labels, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners dominate for sections and cards, with a subtle radius (~4px) applied to interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a spacious and uncrowded feel.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the highly dynamic and artistic hero illustration that completely transforms its scene as the user scrolls, creating a narrative or journey effect. This complex, scroll-triggered visual storytelling, combined with a unique grainy art style, elevates it beyond typical hero animations.
